Philosophy The philosophy of the University Library Services is the conviction that a modern university library should strive at all times to raise the intellectual capacity of its community through equitable access to information, innovation in service delivery, and responsive support for lifelong learning. 885K+ Collections About Haruna Wakili Library Your Gateway to Knowledge Sule Lamido University Library strives to provide a well-equipped library comprising physical and e-resources which are rich in content for easy access within the University and outside.
